Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ucdpR 0.7.1

  • Added the package author’s ORCID identifier to the structured package metadata so it is displayed and linked by pkgdown.
  • Standardized the pkgdown navigation with an explicit Articles dropdown that provides direct access to the getting-started guide and research-workflow vignettes.
  • Added README.Rmd as the canonical README source so the rendered README.md can be regenerated with devtools::build_readme().

ucdpR 0.7.0

  • Ensured ucdp_to_priogrid() works across supported terra releases whose matrix-coordinate extraction method does not accept an ID argument.
  • Added ucdp_to_priogrid() to assign georeferenced UCDP observations to the pgid cells produced by the released priogrid package. Custom or frozen grid rasters are supported for reproducible and future-compatible workflows.
  • Added ucdp_country_crosswalk() for explicit, year-sensitive conversion between Gleditsch-Ward and Correlates of War country identifiers, using peacesciencer or a user-supplied frozen crosswalk.
  • Added ucdp_to_peacesciencer() to standardize state-year and dyad-year keys, verify their uniqueness, and declare the attributes expected by peacesciencer.
  • Added an interoperability vignette, help-page examples, and synthetic tests.

ucdpR 0.6.0

  • Added ucdp_aggregate() for event counts and fatality-bound aggregation at country, PRIO-GRID, conflict, and dyad units with yearly or monthly periods.
  • Added ucdp_panel() to construct complete analytical panels from raw or aggregated data. Inserted combinations are explicitly identified as zero-filled or missing and never silently presented as observed groups.
  • Added ucdp_fatalities() to summarize low, best, and high UCDP fatality estimates with completeness diagnostics and configurable missing-value behavior.
  • Expanded tests, examples, README guidance, and the reproducible-research vignette for aggregation and panel workflows.

ucdpR 0.5.1

  • Added four focused vignettes covering data access and versioning, spatial workflows, uncertainty and revisions, and reproducible research.
  • Reworked the getting-started vignette into a concise package overview.
  • Expanded help-page examples for every exported function, using runnable synthetic data and catalogs wherever the function does not require network access or file downloads.

ucdpR 0.5.0

  • Added ucdp_as_sf() for provenance-preserving conversion of georeferenced UCDP data to optional sf point objects.
  • Added ucdp_precision() and ucdp_filter_precision() to describe and filter GED spatial and temporal precision codes.
  • Added ucdp_version_history() to retrieve official current or historical dataset version histories.
  • Added ucdp_replication_catalog() and ucdp_replication_download() for publication-specific frozen data, codebooks, version histories, and supplementary files in UCDP’s official replication archive.
  • Added ucdp_schema() to inspect variable classes, missingness, uniqueness, ranges, examples, and attached provenance.
  • Added sf as an optional dependency and excluded the default local replication/ download directory from builds and version control.

ucdpR 0.4.1

  • Excluded the suggested local documentation/ download directory from source builds and version control so saved codebooks do not trigger an R CMD check NOTE.

ucdpR 0.4.0

  • Added ucdp_metadata() to summarize dataset provenance, dimensions, temporal coverage, and coordinate coverage from imported objects, downloaded paths, or catalog records.
  • Added ucdp_codebook() to locate and download official UCDP codebooks, including exact-version safeguards and support for documentation variants.
  • Added ucdp_validate() with structured diagnostics for observation keys, dates, fatality estimates, coordinates, and selected UCDP codes.
  • New downloads now retain retrieval time and the ucdpR package version in addition to the catalog record, dataset version, and checksum.

ucdpR 0.3.4

  • Reframed the package documentation around reproducible UCDP research workflows and present and future convenience functions, rather than data downloading alone.
  • Expanded the README and introductory vignette with a dedicated release- comparison workflow and clearer guidance on package scope and direction.

ucdpR 0.3.3

  • Corrected the synthetic HTML fixture used to test catalog text extraction. The fixture now spells “Yearly Datasets” correctly while retaining the nested-element structure that guards against dropped letters.

ucdpR 0.3.2

  • Corrected clean_text(): its former regular expression removed the literal lower-case letters n, r, and t under R’s default regex engine. Whitespace normalization now relies solely on the portable POSIX space class.
  • Documented the print() and summary() methods separately so their method arguments no longer produce an R CMD check warning.

ucdpR 0.3.1

  • Fixed catalog titles losing lower-case n, r, and t characters because CSS-aware text extraction treated UCDP’s one-letter markup as hidden.
  • Restricted URL-based canonical naming to genuine fallback cases, preventing auxiliary datasets from being relabeled as similarly named core datasets.
  • Applied the same robust text extraction to citation discovery.

ucdpR 0.3.0

  • Added ucdp_compare_versions() to audit retrospective changes between two downloaded or preloaded UCDP releases. It reports schema changes and added, removed, modified, and unchanged observations, with optional cell-level details and numeric tolerance.

ucdpR 0.2.3

  • CSV imports now detect type-guessing failures and automatically re-read with full-file inference. This correctly treats occasionally comma-separated UCDP identifier fields as character without slowing every import by default.
  • Explicit readr controls such as col_types and guess_max remain honored.

ucdpR 0.2.2

  • Removed a non-ASCII character from executable R code.
  • Qualified utils::head() for clean static code analysis.
  • Excluded development-only files from the CRAN source archive.

ucdpR 0.2.1

  • Fixed live catalog discovery after UCDP served dataset headings at a different HTML level than the rendered page suggested.
  • Fixed the multiple-match diagnostic so it includes a stable headline and can be tested reliably.

ucdpR 0.2.0

  • Historical releases are now discovered from UCDP’s dedicated archive.
  • Added ucdp_versions() to inspect downloadable versions before selection.
  • version now supports annual and monthly Candidate release identifiers.
  • Downloads and imported objects retain source, version, and checksum metadata.
  • Improved detection of historical dyadic and conflict-level variants.

ucdpR 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added live catalog discovery, search, download, import, citation, and update checking helpers.
